title: Drupal JSON:API Resource
description: Schema representing a Drupal JSON:API resource object following the JSON:API 1.1 specification as implemented by the Drupal JSON:API module. Resource objects are returned from all /jsonapi/{entity_type}/{bundle} endpoints and encapsulate entity data including attributes (field values), relationships (entity references), and navigation links.

jsonapi.description: JSON:API version information included in all responses.

version.description: The JSON:API specification version in use.

meta.description: Non-standard meta-information about the JSON:API implementation.

oneOf.description: An array of resource objects for collection responses.

data.description: The primary data of the response. Either a single resource object or an array of resource objects.

included.description: An array of resource objects that are related to the primary data and included via the include query parameter.

links.description: Links related to the primary data.

meta.description: Non-standard meta-information about the response, such as total result count for collections.

count.description: Total number of resources matching the current filter across all pages.

errors.description: An array of error objects. Present when the request resulted in one or more errors.

ResourceObject.description: A JSON:API resource object representing a single Drupal entity with its type, UUID, attributes, and relationships.

type.description: The JSON:API resource type in the format {entity_type}--{bundle}, e.g. node--article, taxonomy_term--tags, user--user, file--file.

id.description: The UUID of the Drupal entity. JSON:API always uses UUID as the resource identifier, not the numeric entity ID.

attributes.description: The entity's field values excluding entity reference fields. Common attributes include title, status, created, changed, langcode, and content-type-specific fields.

drupal_internal__nid.description: The internal numeric node ID (informational only, not used as primary identifier).

drupal_internal__tid.description: The internal numeric taxonomy term ID (informational only).

drupal_internal__uid.description: The internal numeric user ID (informational only).

drupal_internal__fid.description: The internal numeric file ID (informational only).

langcode.description: The language code for this resource translation.

status.description: Publication or active status of the entity.

title.description: Title or name of the entity.

created.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of entity creation.

changed.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of last modification.

promote.description: For nodes, whether the entity is promoted to the front page.

sticky.description: For nodes, whether the entity is sticky at the top of lists.

name.description: Name field used for taxonomy terms and user accounts.

description.description: Description field for taxonomy terms and vocabularies.

path.description: URL alias configuration for the entity.

filesize.description: File size in bytes for file entities.

relationships.description: The entity's entity reference fields expressed as relationship objects. Each key is a field machine name.

links.description: Links related to this resource object.

meta.description: Non-standard meta-information about this resource object.

RelationshipObject.description: A JSON:API relationship object representing an entity reference field.

oneOf.description: Array of resource linkage objects for multi-value entity reference fields.

data.description: The resource linkage data identifying the related resource(s).

links.description: Links for this relationship including self and related URLs.

ResourceLinkage.description: A resource linkage object within a relationship, identifying a related resource by type and UUID.

type.description: The resource type of the related entity.

id.description: The UUID of the related entity.

meta.description: Non-standard meta-information about the relationship linkage.

Links.description: A links object containing URL references for navigation and pagination.

self.description: The URL of the current resource or collection.

related.description: The URL of a related resource.

first.description: The URL of the first page in a paginated collection.

prev.description: The URL of the previous page in a paginated collection.

next.description: The URL of the next page in a paginated collection.

last.description: The URL of the last page in a paginated collection.

Link.description: A single link object with an href URL and optional meta.

TextFieldValue.description: A Drupal formatted text field value as returned in JSON:API attribute objects.

value.description: The raw text content before format processing.

format.description: The machine name of the text format (e.g., basic_html, full_html, plain_text).

processed.description: The text content after applying text format filters. Computed by Drupal, read-only.

summary.description: Optional summary text. Used for teasers when body has a configured summary.

PathAliasValue.description: URL alias information for a Drupal entity as returned in JSON:API.

alias.description: The URL alias path starting with a forward slash (e.g., /my-article).

langcode.description: The language code for this path alias.

FileUriValue.description: A file URI value object as returned in JSON:API file entity attributes.

value.description: The file URI in Drupal stream wrapper format (e.g., public://2024/01/image.jpg).

url.description: The absolute URL to the file for direct download or display.

Error.description: A JSON:API error object describing a single error encountered while processing a request.

id.description: A unique identifier for this particular error occurrence.

status.description: The HTTP status code applicable to this error.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem. Should not change between occurrences.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this error occurrence.

source.description: References to the source of the error.

pointer.description: A JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the associated entity in the request body.

parameter.description: The URI query parameter that caused the error.

links.description: Links that may lead to further details about this error.

about.description: A link to further information about this error.
